committee_name.text: Dermatologic and Ophthalmic Drugs Advisory Committee

quote.quote: The Dermatologic and Ophthalmic Drugs Advisory Committee of the Food and Drug Administration met on June 26, 2009 at the Hilton Hotel Washington/Silver Spring, 8727 Colesville Road, Silver Spring, Maryland. Michael X. Repka, M.D., chaired the meeting.
Since this is a NME (new molecular entity) advisory committee was convened on June 26, 2009.

recommendation.text: The committee voted 7-Yes and 0-No, unanimously concluding that adequate safety and efficacy had been demonstrated for the treatment of itching due to allergic conjunctivitis.

quote.quote: The committee unanimously concluded that adequate safety and efficacy for bepotastine ophthalmic solution had been demonstrated for the treatment of itching due to allergic conjunctivitis. All committee members stated they based their decision on Studies ISTA-BEPO-CS01, CL-S&E-0409071, and CL-SAF-0405071.

summary: A Dermatologic and Ophthalmic Drugs Advisory Committee meeting was convened on June 26, 2009 because bepotastine was a new molecular entity. The committee voted 7-Yes and 0-No, unanimously concluding that adequate safety and efficacy had been demonstrated for treatment of itching due to allergic conjunctivitis. The review documents describe a straightforward positive endorsement with no committee concerns tied to any change in the approval (no boxed warning, REMS, indication narrowing, or PMR/PMC linked to the AdComm).
